title: •There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement
caption: •There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (V)
game_text: Deploy on Conference Room. Revolution is canceled here. You may not deploy aliens (except Mara Jade and bounty hunters), {episode1} cards, or Luke? Luuuuke!. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present, each Imperial Council Member adds one {dark-force}. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ one Laser Gate, an Imperial Council Member, or a Political Effect. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. {alter}

notes: Unique. Base card is the printed Reflections II combo card 'There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement' (wiki page of that name, destiny 1, PM) — not the separate Dagobah/SE cards the stub's 'Decipher base' line names. NEW FRAME TYPE: the Reflections II combo Effect has NO lore box — the art window (split image, Luke | Death Star throne room) runs from the title bar down to the text box; lore set to "". Printed title shows a dot on BOTH names ('•There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement'); the wiki base page title field drops the first dot (wiki error). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Inline: EPISODE I circle → {episode1}; white square with red diagonal after 'adds one' → {dark-force} (stub 'Force icon'); ▲ where the stub expands it; trailing red circle-slash A → {alter}. 'Luke? Luuuuke!.' printed with the trailing period. Copyright read off the 354 px scan: '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' Modern: VB4 only (-pre 350 px; non-pre also exists).
